# Xelu prompts provenance

Key art for the Keyboard button-icon set comes from "FREE Controller & Key
Prompts" by Nicolae (Xelu) Berbece, published by Those Awesome Guys under
Creative Commons Zero (CC0, public domain). `Readme.txt` in this directory is
the pack's own readme.

## Source

- URL: https://thoseawesomeguys.com/prompts/Xelu_Free_Controller&Key_Prompts.zip
- ZIP size: 6560174 bytes
- ZIP SHA-256: 2848fd4259437a6f594f81ff8d8d7a1f922397c7e9da163b2535aa82ae1df037

its original CRLF; the hash below is of the original member.

## Transformation

`scripts/build_keyboard_icons.py` turns each PNG into
`assets/button-icons/xelu-light/<SdkKeyName>.dds`: resize to 64x64 with
Lanczos filtering through Pillow (straight alpha preserved), then write a
legacy uncompressed 32-bit B8G8R8A8 DDS of exactly 16512 bytes. The key name to
art mapping lives in that script. `python scripts/build_keyboard_icons.py
--check` regenerates every file and compares the bytes; the checked-in files
were produced with Pillow 12.2.0.
